Overview

Volta Redonda is a city in RJ with a population of 274,925. An industrial city in the Paraíba Valley, home to Brazil’s largest steel mill (CSN) and a major manufacturing center. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
